n287819109c.headline: Britain and EU to resume talks in final push for Brexit trade deal
n287819109c.summary: UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen have instructed negotiators to resume trade talks in a last attempt to bridge differences ahead of Brexit deadlines.
n287819109c.why: Brexit trade negotiations directly affect trade flows, tariffs, and regulatory alignment between the UK and EU, impacting businesses and markets across Europe.
n287819109c.why_moved: Renewed Brexit trade talks create market uncertainty about future UK-EU trade relations, impacting currency and equity markets.

n515a51bc32.headline: Argentina: a tax on large fortunes against Covid-19 and poverty
n515a51bc32.summary: Argentina plans to impose an extraordinary tax on nearly 12,000 wealthy individuals to help address the economic distress caused by the coronavirus pandemic and support the most deprived.
n515a51bc32.why: Extraordinary taxes on large fortunes are fiscal measures aimed at raising government revenue during crises, impacting wealth distribution and potentially investment sentiment.

nd57a2c63b4.headline: There’ll be hunger if recession lasts longer –Ibrahim, All Farmers Association of Nigeria factional President
nd57a2c63b4.summary: The All Farmers Association of Nigeria warns that prolonged recession could lead to increased hunger and food insecurity.
nd57a2c63b4.why: Agricultural sector stability is vital for Nigeria's food security and overall economic resilience.
